<script>
function bcToggleMics() {
  var hidden = document.body.classList.toggle('hide-mics');
  document.getElementById('mic-toggle').textContent = hidden ? 'Show Open Mics' : 'Hide Open Mics';
  localStorage.setItem('bcHideMics', hidden ? '1' : '0');
}
(function() {
  if (localStorage.getItem('bcHideMics') === '1') {
    document.body.classList.add('hide-mics');
  }
})();
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('mic-toggle');
  if (btn && document.body.classList.contains('hide-mics')) {
    btn.textContent = 'Show Open Mics';
  }
});
</script>
